baseline_facts_to_reproduce.audit_deadline_note: The retained audit reports all 3434 records past their review deadline; retained safety_flags are generation assertions, not a newly established freshness pass.
baseline_facts_to_reproduce.denominator_warning: Do not substitute the 157 published-record WP9 positioning denominator for the 3434 research baseline or report 2905 proposals as qualified parsed dictionaries.

field_state_design_constraints.applicability: Represent supported, unsupported, not_applicable and unknown as distinct decisions. Conflict/dispute must remain visible and cannot be encoded as missing or false.
field_state_design_constraints.attempt: Represent not_attempted separately from attempted success, failed, restricted, blocked, unavailable and not_applicable; bind an attempted outcome to a check/observation ID and actual observed/recorded timestamps.
field_state_design_constraints.evidence: Use core evidence references with observed_at, evidence_state, staleness_state, derivation lineage and review status; retain source/content locators and hashes.
field_state_design_constraints.history: A later failure or expiry changes the current derived state while retaining historical successful revisions and their evidence; no destructive replacement.
field_state_design_constraints.interface_note: No exact new field-property names are prescribed by this preparation. The implementer must document the versioned interface and any shared-contract ownership change before editing outside PR-004 scope.
field_state_design_constraints.readiness: Research readiness is derived only when required field states and evidence/attempt conditions satisfy the frozen rule; a rendered unknown card is never ready.
field_state_design_constraints.value: Use typed claim values, including explicit unknown/null; never coerce unknown or unavailable to boolean false.

reuse_map.area: core truth, evidence and field identity
limits: The current core schemas do not provide a complete field-level applicability/attempt envelope. If PR-004 adds one, version it under the owned identity schema scope and bind it to these contracts; do not overload epistemic_state or create a second truth envelope.
The core access schema prohibits workflow submission, payload acquisition and raw payload storage; no field state may imply those actions.
reuse_for: Keep value, evidence, applicability and attempt concepts in separate dimensions while retaining core clocks, evidence references, typed unknown values, exact native IDs and append-only revisions.
Use field_role=identifier and nativeIdentifier for source identity; there is no physical-unit slot on nativeIdentifier.

limits: Current legacy normalization maps unresolved values to unknown and uses route-level access states. It is a reusable boundary, not proof that a field was attempted or scientifically qualified.
Current normalizeLegacyCorpus is a v1.1 compatibility import; PR-004 must not silently change its frozen output or make the 157 published-record view the 3434-record research denominator.
reuse_for: Produce deterministic field observations attached to exact source/release/schema revisions, evidence IDs, coverage intervals, clocks and lineage.
Retain a prior successful value/revision when a later attempt is failed, restricted or stale; create an append-only successor rather than deleting the prior fact.
Preserve candidate joins and review candidates as unresolved; title/URL similarity is not identity evidence.

reuse_map.area: access aging and exact schema/join gates
limits: A route observation is not a field observation. PR-004 must reference route checks where relevant and keep unsupported, not-applicable, not-attempted, restricted, failed and conflict distinguishable at field level.
reuse_for: As-of derivation filters both observed and recorded clocks, returns unknown when no eligible observation exists, and marks elapsed stale_at without erasing the historical state.
Pin field observations to immutable snapshot/release/distribution/field revisions; expose blocked, conditional and unknown join readiness without promotion.
Carry typed authorization, unavailable, malformed, timeout and unresolved outcomes through attempt coverage; a recipe is guidance and never execution authorization.

limits: These boundaries verify identity/lineage and projection integrity; they do not establish source payload availability or research fitness.
reuse_for: Build field ledger inputs only from sealed, exact, one-job-per-capture worksets and exact record/evidence/schema mappings.
Keep duplicate, missing, aggregate, unsealed, conflicting and rejected inputs visible; preserve rejected rows for audit and disable their projection.
Use publication-context/hash guards and zero-result non-absence semantics for offline consumers.

limits: The existing WP9 artifact counts 14 source scopes, 51 jurisdictions, 306 cells and a separate 157 published-record positioning denominator. Those concepts are non-additive and are not the PR-004 3434-record field denominator.
Canonical coverage cell states (integrated/candidate/navigation_only/evidence_gap/inaccessible/unknown/not_assessed) are not a replacement for field applicability/attempt states; keep axes distinct.
reuse_for: Copy the versioned snapshot/membership pattern: explicit denominator status, cohort filters, as_of/reporting window, revision pins, membership manifest hash, partition counts, unknown/not-applicable/excluded/unclassified counts and null rates for unknown/zero denominators.
Expose an immutable, bounded, offline artifact with context-preserving filters and digest/cursor checks; aggregate scores remain supplemental to a complete per-field vector.
Use denominator-subset, partition, incomplete-enumeration and absence-claim guards as arithmetic patterns.

reuse_map.area: source-bound extraction and review-only dictionary evidence
limits: These scripts do not acquire payloads, prove release continuity, authorize access, establish units or certify join/scientific fitness. Do not turn their pending_owner_review/publication_authorized=false outputs into success counts.
reuse_for: Bind field claims to exact publisher metadata bytes, capture hashes, JSON pointers, raw-value hashes, source IDs and generation; preserve typed limitations.
Treat the 2905 packaged dictionary proposals as source-bound pending-owner material with unresolved schema applicability, not as qualified dictionaries.
